on CalculateTeacherBadges
	
	local tBadgesArrayA,tMilestonesArrayA, tCreated,tIcons
	local tFile,tMilestones,tBades,tMemberSince
	local tNumberofSecondsIn2Years = 63072000
	// NO LEAP YEAR
	local tNumberOfSecondsInWeek = 604800
	
	if updateBadgesMilestones = "true" then	
		
		// BADGES
		put "3ffa6e3a-53c8-4fdb-b211-543a762125d6" into tIcons["profile-pro"]
		put "b2a3bf1e-2075-4e4f-ac6b-9747125a0f1b" into tIcons["class-importer"]
		put "cffe1cc3-ba26-4934-a6a4-e2afec49cb1c" into tIcons["first-quiz"]
		put "29a3977d-f76f-4ea7-aa72-e0f086dce394" into tIcons["power-ten"]
		put "a5d5b405-3a1a-44cf-8639-bc42939045d0" into tIcons["quick-start"]
		put "108d145a-4125-4e39-8a97-e5fcdbc62ffd" into tIcons["connect-five"]
		put "d70fce5e-d06a-4079-be7e-1392d14ce315" into tIcons["invite-sent"]
		put "7e5a8e9d-67cc-4d5f-b7ff-2c1583e20937" into tIcons["quiz-creator"]
		put "176eb9cb-fb5d-4be7-a823-65c7dd58cb14" into tIcons["ai-powered"]
		put "f2c0d58c-b887-4a6d-adac-cd7adab86764" into tIcons["rubric-builder"]
		put "855c90cc-bdc6-41a4-9a31-c8cb74982a42" into tIcons["team-player"]
		// MILESTONES
		put "5b1bbd10-da81-4cd1-9530-8601c9694541" into tIcons["lightning"]
		put "48e1e721-4583-4b40-bd0b-9caea584cc55" into tIcons["trophy"]
		put "4f07767b-5eca-48e4-9995-d5614286f06d" into tIcons["star"]
		put "2fb0248f-1987-4dc9-a1da-bc7b23cdeaea" into tIcons["document"]
		
		
		// POPULATE MILESTONES & HEADINGS
		put "Yahoo!" into tMilestonesArrayA["1"]["heading"]
		put "You're a People Person!" into tMilestonesArrayA["2"]["heading"]
		put "You're on a Roll" into tMilestonesArrayA["3"]["heading"]
		put "Congratulations!" into tMilestonesArrayA["4"]["heading"]
		
		// -----------
		// 2 YEARS?
		put "You have been in the Quizli family for 2 years now!" into tMilestonesArrayA["1"]["text"]
		local tUserID
		put teacherRecordID into tUserID
		put teacherRecordA[tUserID]["cdb"]["cdbDateCreated"] into tMemberSince
		
		if (the seconds - tMemberSince) > tNumberOfSecondsIn2Years then
			put 0 into tMilestonesArrayA["1"]["blendlevel"]
		else
			put 75 into tMilestonesArrayA["1"]["blendlevel"]
		end if	
		
		// TEACHER REFERALLS
		put "<n> new teachers used your referral code." into tMilestonesArrayA["2"]["text"]
		replace "<n>" with teacherRecord_TotalReferrals in tMilestonesArrayA["2"]["text"]
		
		if teacherRecord_TotalReferrals = 0 then
			put 75 into tMilestonesArrayA["2"]["blendlevel"]
		else
			put 0 into tMilestonesArrayA["2"]["blendlevel"]
		end if
		
		
		// THIS WEEK AND LIFETIME
		
		local tIsWithinLast2Weeks
		
		put the seconds - tNumberOfSecondsInWeek into tIsWithinLast2Weeks
		
		// GO OVER RECORDS OF MILESTONES
		
		put "You created <n> new Quizlis this week." into tMilestonesArrayA["3"]["text"]
		put "<n> lifetime Quizlis created." into tMilestonesArrayA["4"]["text"]
		
		
		put tIcons["star"] into tMilestonesArrayA["1"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["trophy"] into tMilestonesArrayA["2"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["lightning"] into tMilestonesArrayA["3"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["document"] into tMilestonesArrayA["4"]["iconBlob"]
		
		// BADGES
		put tIcons["profile-pro"] into tBadgesArrayA["1"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["class-importer"] into tBadgesArrayA["2"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["first-quiz"] into tBadgesArrayA["3"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["power-ten"] into tBadgesArrayA["4"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["quick-start"] into tBadgesArrayA["5"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["connect-five"] into tBadgesArrayA["6"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["invite-sent"] into tBadgesArrayA["7"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["quiz-creator"] into tBadgesArrayA["8"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["ai-powered"] into tBadgesArrayA["9"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["rubric-builder"] into tBadgesArrayA["10"]["iconBlob"]
		put tIcons["team-player"] into tBadgesArrayA["11"]["iconBlob"]
		
		
		// WHAT BADGES HAS THE TEACHER EARNED?
		// WE READ THESE FROM MileStonesBadges_TEACHERID TABLE
		
		put tMilestonesArrayA into teacher_Milestones 
		put tBadgesArrayA into teacher_Badges
		put "false" into updateBadgesMilestones 
	end if
end CalculateTeacherBadges
